label: E9-1
title: Let the final event check accept four-digit decision numbers?
now: Every history type we add needs its own entry in the decision log, and about 510 are coming (from your EA-P1 to EA-P3 answers). The frozen final check that proves the event list is complete only accepts three-digit decision numbers (up to DL-999), and only 489 of those are left, shared with every other stream. The first 173 additions fit; the rest do not. Changing that frozen check needs your yes (your 'no other edits' rule, DL-039).

options.label: Allow four-digit numbers (DL-1000 and up)
options.gets: All additions fit. A small change to the check's number pattern, written by a separate agent, reviewed blind and pinned by the reseal, like the earlier approved check changes.
options.costs: About half a day of agent work, bundled with the next check landing.

options.label: Keep three digits; let one decision entry cover several types
options.gets: No change to the frozen check.
options.costs: Bends your rule of one decision entry per type (DL-400); each entry would list many types.

options.label: Keep three digits and stop at what fits
options.costs: About 20 types can't be added, so the final plan check can't pass.

recommendation.why: It is a one-line pattern change that keeps your one-entry-per-type rule intact.
recommendation.flip: If you want the frozen check never touched again

neededBy.ifNoAnswer: The first 173 additions go ahead on three-digit numbers; the rest wait.

reversible.how: The pattern change can be reverted before any four-digit entry lands
